name: DominoPilot – AI Live Chat Assistant
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPilot AI Live Chat Assistant is a powerful chatbot plugin that transforms how you interact with your visitors. Powered by advanced AI models (such as LongCat AI), the assistant scans your WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products on-the-fly to provide instant, accurate, and context-aware responses to user queries.

Key Features:

  • Smart Store Integration: Automatically scans WooCommerce products to answer questions about price, availability, and product details.
  • Site-Aware Responses: Answers questions based on your existing posts and pages, ensuring the AI only provides relevant information.
  • Customizable UI: Easily change the chat window title, welcome message, and “thinking” text directly from your dashboard.
  • Zero Configuration Needed: Comes entirely pre-configured with a powerful default model and API key. Just activate and go!
  • Markdown Link Support: The assistant provides clickable links to products and articles for a seamless shopping experience.

Service Disclosure:

This plugin relies on third-party AI services to generate responses. By default, it is configured to work with the LongCat AI API endpoint.
* Service Used: The plugin securely sends visitor chat messages (along with relevant site context) to the LongCat AI API.
* Data Sharing: Visitor chat prompts and limited website context (such as matched product descriptions) are sent to the external API provider for processing.
* Privacy Policy: Please refer to the LongCat AI Privacy Policy for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopilot-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Domino Pilot” menu to configure your Chat Settings.
  4. Check the “Enable Live Chat” box to display the widget on your site front-end!
sections.faq:
Do I need to provide my own API key?

No! The plugin comes pre-configured with a default LongCat API key and model so you can start using it immediately without any advanced setup.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The AI automatically scans your WooCommerce product database when a user asks a question, providing details such as price, availability, and a direct link to the product.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Absolutely. You can customize the chat window title, the initial welcome message, and the loading indicator text from the Domino Pilot settings page.
